decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already makes mint statistics restart with the new active contract and exclude old-contract NFT copies; no additional change is required.
The existing message-539 MODIFY fully captures that referral codes use restarted mint numbers from the new active contract and exclude old-contract mint numbers from project systems.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits dashboard reward and ticket accounting to the new active contract and excludes old-contract NFT data.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records that draws and active ticket state start with the new contract and exclude old-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY fully limits public referral aggregates to new-contract activity and excludes referral data associated with old-contract copies.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts random no-code reward recipients to holders in the new active contract and excludes holders represented only by old-contract copies.
The existing message-539 MODIFY fully captures that only NFTs minted by the new active contract provide valid referral codes and old-contract mint numbers are invalid.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restarts draw eligibility under the new active contract and excludes old-contract NFTs, tickets, and prior draw state.
Changing which contract's NFTs are used by project systems does not alter the requirement to display NFT cover images completely and without cropping.
The source decision does not change which metadata fields must be visible on NFTs from the active contract; the existing metadata visibility attributes remain valid unchanged.
Excluding old-contract NFTs from project systems does not change the referral milestones or conditions used to award badges on the active system.
The contract transition does not change the selected badge set, icons, count, or dashboard grid layout.
